name: A Taste of Flame
summary: Cyrus Therepentous asks you to prove your worth. He already seems to doubt you.

sections.title: Cyrus's Test
sections.body: Cyrus Therepentous watches you with eyes that blaze like two spheres. He asks you to show proof of your worth, though you sense he believes you are unworthy.

faq.answer: Cyrus Therepentous asks you to show proof of your worth.
You sense that Cyrus already believes you are unworthy.

faq.q: What happens when Cyrus watches me?
faq.answer: Cyrus's eyes form two blazing spheres.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Taste of Flame
